title: Your Next Steps
use_cases: Use when refining the emotional resonance and clarity of a manuscript query letter
Implement when auditing a synopsis to ensure stakes and consequences are clearly defined
Configure when setting up a peer-review test to validate the effectiveness of a pitch
Use when determining the optimal timing for sending submissions to literary agents
content:
Take your current query letter and look at your synopsis ending. Does it have a clear stakes sentence following the formula?

If not, rewrite it now using:

[Character] must decide if [choice/action] is worth [consequence/risk]

Be specific. Be clear. Make the choice emotionally resonant.

Then ask someone who hasn’t read your manuscript to read just your query. Set a timer for 60 seconds, then quiz them. Can they tell you exactly what your protagonist must decide and what they might lose?

If yes, you’re ready to query.

If you’re preparing to send queries soon, timing matters too. Check out our guide on when to query literary agents to maximize your chances of success.

Good luck!
